en: This CORE class aims to introduce new players to Trading in EVE Online.
zh: 本 CORE 课程旨在向新玩家介绍 EVE Online 中的贸易。

blocks.en: Introduction to Trade teaches the basics of Trading in EVE Online, how to go about buying and selling goods, and hopefully making a profit while doing so.
blocks.zh: 贸易入门课讲解 EVE Online 贸易的基础知识：如何买卖商品，并争取在此过程中赚到利润。

blocks.zh: 本 CORE 课程涵盖以下主题：

zh: 空间站交易与贸易中心
